headlines.description: — Sidney Crosby and Rickard Rakell scored in a shootout and the Pittsburgh Penguins beat the Winnipeg Jets 5-4 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sidney Crosby and Rickard Rakell score in shootout to lead Penguins over Jets, 5-4

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Nashville Predators

headlines.description: — Steven Stamkos had two goals and an assist to lead the Nashville Predators to a 4-1 win over the Vegas Golden Knights on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stamkos' 3-point game powers the Predators to a 4-1 win over the Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Vladimir Tarasenko scored 3:06 into overtime and the Minnesota Wild beat the Dallas Stars 2-1 on Saturday in what could be a first-round playoff preview.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tarasenko scores in OT as Wild top Stars 2-1

events.name: Buffalo Sabres at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Zach Benson had a goal and an assist and the Buffalo Sabres continued their white-hot play with a 4-1 win over the Los Angeles Kings on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sabres stay hot, win 4th straight by pulling away 4-1 over Kings

events.name: Philadelphia Flyers at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Christian Dvorak scored a tiebreaking goal early in the third period and added an assist, Dan Vladar made 24 saves and the Philadelphia Flyers beat the San Jose Sharks 4-1 on Saturday to complete a three-game West Coast sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flyers beat the Sharks 4-1 to complete a three-game West Coast sweep

events.name: Seattle Kraken at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Columbus scored three times in the first period and beat the Seattle Kraken 5-2 on Saturday, extending the Blue Jackets’ point streak to 12 games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blue Jackets extend point streak to 12, beat Kraken 5-2

events.name: New York Islanders at Montreal Canadiens

headlines.description: — Cole Caufield scored three goals to push his season total to 43 and added two assists to help the Montreal Canadiens beat the New York Islanders 7-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cole Caufield has a hat trick in 5-point game to help the Canadiens beat the Islanders 7-3

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Ottawa Senators

headlines.description: — The Ottawa Senators had a dominant game against their provincial rivals beating the Toronto Maple Leafs 5-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Senators dominate Maple Leafs in 5-2 win

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Vancouver Canucks

headlines.description: — Pius Suter and Pavel Buchnevich scored in a 1:19 span in the second period and the St. Louis Blues beat the NHL-worst Vancouver Canucks 3-1 on Saturday to end a two-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blues beat the NHL-worst Canucks 3-1 to end 2-game losing streak

events.name: Boston Bruins at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Defenseman Nikita Zadorov broke a tie at 9:42 of the third period and the Boston Bruins beat the Detroit Red Wings 4-2 on Saturday night in an Eastern Conference wild-card showdown.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bruins beat the Red Wings 4-2 in an Eastern Conference wild-card showdown

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Edmonton Oilers

headlines.description: — Nikita Kucherov had two goals and two assists to take the NHL scoring lead from Edmonton star Connor McDavid in the Tampa Bay Lightning's 5-2 victory over the Oilers on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kucherov takes the NHL points lead from McDavid in the Lightning's 5-2 victory over the Oilers
